topic: Finite geometric sums over the real numbers.
questions: What is the exact formula for G_n(q)=sum_{k=0}^{n-1} q^k, including q = 1?
objects: A real number q and a positive integer n.
include: Definition, q != 1 formula, q = 1 case, and multiply-and-subtract mechanism.
exclude: Infinite series, convergence, matrices, and historical priority claims.
